_comment: The graph POST /openai/v1/images/generations renders. It ships here rather
than in operator config because the wiring is the part that fails silently:
a mis-wired node returns a black image or a shape error from deep inside
comfy, not a message naming the graph. What varies by install is only the
checkpoint filenames, which come from the comfy route's [route.args].
Every string of the form ${name} is replaced by the door before submission,
with the substituted value keeping its own type -- ${width} becomes a
number, not the string "512". An unfilled placeholder is refused rather
than sent, so a graph edit that names something the door does not supply
fails at the request instead of rendering something wrong.
Node ids are strings because that is comfy's own prompt format.
